d:
The song you love, now with the soul of a qawwali Tere Bina Na Guzara E (Qawwali Version) by Josh Brar turns a heartfelt love song into a soul-stirring Sufi qawwali, with Salamat Ali Matoi and Josh Brar composing and Agaazz making the music.
Claps, harmonium and raw emotion bring a whole new depth to every word. It’s for every heart that simply can’t live without someone
Song - Tere Bina Na Guzara E (Qawwali Version)
Artist - Josh Brar
Lyrics - Jagdeep Warring, Josh Brar, Bunty Bains
Music - Agaazz
Composer - Salamat Ali Matoi, Josh Brar
Label - Speed Records
